title: A Gangster Pulled A Knife On Two Students . . . Then A Powerful Family Buried It (Episode 4)
caption:
Weak Hero Class 1, episode 4: Rex's men drag Max and Bobby into a van, and it ends in an abandoned theme park.
Sam, Max and Amy take on a gangster with a knife, then learn a powerful family is covering it all up. Follow for episode 5!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom
comment: Would you have walked into that theme park to save Max and Bobby? Why?

segments.say: A gangster pulls a knife on two high school kids, and ends up flat on the *ground*.
To see how it got here, go back to the night his men dragged Max and Bobby *away*.
Rex's men load Max into a car like *cargo*, and Bobby watches, terrified.
Rex loses it. Is that kid really coming with the *cops*?
Then police lights flash down the street, and his crew *scatter*.
Rex calls Jake, his old right-hand man. Come to Mangu-dong, he says. And bring *Amy*.
If they don't show, he will sell the boy beside him. That's Tim, only *fourteen*.
Jake knows Rex means it, so he tells Amy to stay here and hide. Don't *follow* me.
That was either brave or *stupid*.
But Amy is not the type to sit and wait. She calls the one person she *trusts*. Sam.
Sam is already standing in Rex's house. It's empty, with only *blood* on the floor.
Amy tells him to track her phone and bring the police, or they will all *die*.
Then she hangs up and chases after Jake. Take me with you, she begs. But he *refuses*.
Then a message lights up a phone. Come to Mangu-dong first. Your *friends* are there. And Sam doesn't wait. He *runs*.
Mangu-dong turns out to be an abandoned theme park, and Rex sits in the middle of it like a *king*.
Max and Bobby sit tied up on the ground, bruised but *alive*.
Max asks why Bobby is even here. I came to hand over the money, Bobby says. So now I'm tied up *too*.
Jake and Amy creep through the park. Don't do anything stupid, he tells her. She says it's all her *fault*.
Then Jake walks in alone, straight toward *Rex*.
I fed you and gave you a roof, Rex says. Why would you *betray* me?
Jake doesn't argue. He just asks Rex to hit *him*.
Rex smiles, and beats him into the *dirt*.
Amy can't watch. Stop, she screams, and Rex's men drag her *back*.
Then Rex turns to Tim. Fourteen years old, and *terrified*.
You already stabbed those kids, Rex tells him. And minors don't go to *prison*.
He wants a kid doing his dirty work.
Then Rex plays eeny, meeny, miny, moe over the tied-up boys. This might *sting*, he grins.
That's when a voice cuts in. *Enough*. Jake is back on his feet, and Rex goes flying.
Just you and me, Jake tells him. If you lose, you *leave*.
Jake wins round one. Rex crashes into a pile of *junk*.
But Rex doesn't fight fair. His men pile on, and Jake goes *down*.
That was never a fair *fight*.
Then Amy steps out holding a *knife*. Nobody move, she says. But Rex walks right up and grabs her by the *throat*. This is what you get for hanging around with Jake, he snarls.
And that is when *Sam* walks in.
It's over, Sam says. The police are coming, and they will search your *car*.
Rex's men bolt. Amy rushes to Jake, and Max and Bobby look up. Sorry I'm late, Sam says. Untie *us*, Max says.
Max jokes he is never going to a theme park again. Then he spots Rex's men *coming back*.
It was a bluff, Rex roars. You made a *fool* of me!
The brawl is on. Fists, tires, and nobody backs *down*.
This time it's *true*. A real officer, gun drawn. Hands up!
But Rex smooths it over. A misunderstanding, he says. Didn't we play *soccer* together?
Of course he knew a *cop*.
While they talk, Rex slips away, and Sam runs after *him*.
Deep in the park, Sam catches up. Not this kid *again*, Rex groans.
Rex knocks him down, and pulls a *knife*.
Then someone shouts. It's *Max*, running in. There's no other way, he says. You need a good *beating*.
It gets ugly fast. Rex chokes Max, and Sam ends up flat on the *ground*.
Rex pins Max down and keeps hitting. But Max gets up one more time, and Rex hits the dirt. He does not get *up*.
Max can't believe it. Why did you go after him *alone*? You came, didn't you, Sam says. Best friends, worst *plan*.
Outside the gate, Jake tells Amy to run. It's not your *fault*. But a cop is already aiming at *Jake*.
Rex is wheeled off in an ambulance. I'll see you when I get out, he tells Max. *Never* again, Max says.
At the police station, Sam says sorry to Bobby. His plan got Max hurt. And Bobby says sorry *too*.
Then a man in a suit sits them down. Nothing from tonight will reach your family or your *school*.
Sam is told to keep quiet. Somebody powerful was cleaning this *up*.
The man in the suit isn't done. He leads Bobby into a back room, and Rex is *waiting*.
The assemblyman wants you to pay him back, the man tells Bobby. Go ahead. Hit *him*.
But Rex only laughs. Come on, little puppy, he taunts. Hit *me*!
Later, Max lies in a hospital bed with a broken *arm*. Sam and Amy come to see him.
Bobby's family covered it up, Max tells them. Our names are gone, and Rex was arrested. Bobby's dad is a National Assemblyman. No wonder it all *vanished*.
Then Max starts to tease. Are you two dating? Sam says no. Amy says *yes*.
Far away, the assemblyman talks on TV. I am not only an assemblyman, he says. I am a *father*.
Then the TV goes dark, and a boy stands in front of him, *silent*.

segments.text: I shouldn't have taken you in.

segments.say: You are a bad seed, he says. So is that boy *Bobby*?
